## Summary

This is a {{< meta brs-release.status >}} release covering
{{< meta brs-release.region >}} for the reference period
{{< meta brs-release.period >}}.

Total employment in the region rose by 4,300 jobs over the quarter, an
increase of 0.4%. Sector detail is in @tbl-sectors, and the full method is in
the [methodology notes](https://example.gov/brs/methods).

**All figures in this release are *provisional*.**

> Benchmarking aligns the survey estimates with the annual census of
> employment.

## Industry detail

Health care and social assistance accounted for most of the quarterly gain.

| Sector | Jobs (000s) | Change |
|:-------|------------:|-------:|
| Health care | 271.4 | +3.1 |
| Construction | 112.8 | +1.9 |
| Manufacturing | 189.2 | -0.4 |

: Non-farm payroll employment by sector {#tbl-sectors}

### Manufacturing

Employment fell for a third consecutive quarter, the longest run of declines
since 2019.

## Notes

Estimates are seasonally adjusted and rounded to the nearest hundred. A
release is marked Provisional until the annual benchmark is applied.
